source_section: Antal anbud och kontrakterade anbud efter företagsstorlek för leverantören, 2024
interpretation: The observed ~7.55x awards-per-bidder gap between large and micro firms decomposes into ~7.12x bids-per-bidder and ~1.06x awards-per-bid. Descriptive decomposition, NOT causal evidence that software increases bids or wins.
caveats: Publisher's headline 41% contracted bids uses a different subset from the 38.2% supplier-size table; never merge the denominators.
Only tenders with relevant post-award/supplier metadata appear; 2024 post-advertisement coverage 63.7% as of 2025-12-01. Missingness may bias results.
Awarded bids do not necessarily mean delivered contracts, realized supplier revenues, or supplier cash receipts, especially for framework agreements.
Supplier size follows Statistics Sweden's employee-count classification, not EU SME definitions.
All sectors pooled; no CPV48/72 segment inference without matched category-specific supplier-size data.
No AgentMine users, willingness to pay, time saved, customers, or revenue are verified.
product_test: Compare opt-in micro/small experienced suppliers' verified minutes to bid/no-bid decision, qualified submissions per month, and repeat paid usage. Pre-register baseline and require independent human review of requirement extraction; no outcome claims from this historical cross-section.
